notes: The exhaustive mapping table checks every C spell, skill, and TYPE arm plus neighboring numeric IDs that must fall through; real raw_kill dispatch verifies generated corpse descriptions, default cases, and the separate disintegrate dust path (R1/R4/R5c/R5e/R5h).

A staged level-11 Zoomaster kills a level-6 mortal: the pump block carries "$n is dead!  R.I.P.", "You are dead!  Sorry...", the adjacent-room death cry and the exp/37 loss; the linked PL-005 guard (play-lab-m3-death-in-combat) pins the multi-attack round stop that damage()-ending deaths require (#2166).
Level > 5 rolls number(0,3) con loss and the nested number(0,5) second point (level > 20); the level-6 victim exercises the first arm, pinned by the draw stream and the pre/post stat.

Death hands the live descriptor CON_MENU with config.c's MENU bytes; an out-of-range choice re-prints the menu with "That's not a menu choice!". A menu left unanswered would time out under check_idle_passwords (comm.c:2170-2187), so the answers come immediately.
Menu option 1 re-enters through reset_char (hit floored at 1, standing), WELC_MESSG, "$n has entered the game." and the load-room look; the paired score shows the exp loss and the floor.
The killed initiate's corpse carries its gold and the corrected give-object fixture's loaf; look-in lists both, and get from the corpse moves them across with the "There were %d coins." conversion.

C's create_money never assigns a weight - create_obj zeroes it and every pile weighs 0; the port's prototype-less fallback reported 1 and reddened the corpse listing until SetWeight(0) restored C's arithmetic (found by the give-object attachment fix).
The max_npc_corpse_time (5) hourly decay draws number(0,6) for one of four flavor lines to the room.
Decay dumps the corpse's contents to the floor; the room look finds the loaf and the gold pile where the corpse was.
The max_pc_corpse_time (10) variant, observed by the in-room survivor while the re-entered victim rides out the hours at the temple.
The victim's carried loaf lands on the floor when the PC corpse decays; the survivor's look proves it.
ROOM_NEUTRAL (bit 16) forbids PC death: the killing blow resets hit to 1, moves the body to the mortal start room with "You are saved by the gods!" and leaves no corpse.

create_money sets ITEM_WEAR_TAKE on every pile, so attitude_loot's do_get("all corpse") picks the gold up and the room sees "$n gets $p from $P." before get_check_money credits it; the port's prototype-less pile carried no wear flags and the mob-get path skipped it (R1/R5c/R5e).
Unit proof for the instance-level wear-flag override: a synthetic pile reports takeable and a looting mobile receives the room get line and the gold (R1/R5c/R5h).

A claw kill's corpse long description is selected from one_hit's w_type (TYPE_HIT + the mob's attack_type), so TYPE_CLAW yields "The hacked up, bloody corpse..."; the death callback used to receive AttackNormal (0) (R1/R3/R5e).
The death callback receives TYPE_HIT + the weapon offset (slash -> TYPE_SLASH), which is what make_corpse maps to the corpse wording (R1/R5e/R5h).
